soru: What did the label on the painting say?
kanit: The label said only: "Unknown artist, around 1890."

soru: What did Deniz notice in the bottom corner?
tr: Deniz alt köşede ne fark etti?
secenekler: Faint lines that looked like letters
kanit: Under the dark paint of the floor, there were some faint lines.

soru: What was under the woman by the window?
secenekler: A self-portrait of a young woman artist
kanit: there was a completely different painting — a self-portrait of a young woman holding a paintbrush.

soru: Why did Saliha probably paint over her signature?
tr: Saliha imzasının üstünü muhtemelen neden boyadı?
secenekler: So the painting could be sold
kanit: Saliha had painted over her own signature, probably so that the painting could be sold.

soru: What did Mr Veli say about the painting?
tr: Bay Veli tablo hakkında ne dedi?
secenekler: He walked past it for twenty years but never really looked
kanit: Every day for twenty years, I walked past that painting
